notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Minor Update (Windows)
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0 has received a minor fix update for Windows devices (6th June 2019). 

This contains a fix for an issue which was preventing the game from launching for certain users. 

As part of this release, we are deactivating the "logtest" beta version which had been distributed to users who had contacted New Star Games support directly. The current version is identical to that beta version. This should happen automatically as long as you have a connection to Steam; there should be no need to do anything extra in order to exit the "logtest" version and move to the latest version.

notes.title: New patch available (1.1.0)
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0 adds [b]BETA [/b]controller support for players using all language options.
Version 1.1.0 also contains a fix for users of Radeon graphics cards who were encountering missing graphics (white screens).

notes.title: New patch available (1.0.3)
notes.content:
Version 1.0.3  contains a graphical update with a higher-fidelity game world.
It also contains BETA support for controllers/gamepads.

Please use the Steam discussion forum or contact us via support@newstargames.com or "New Star Soccer" on Facebook to let us know how we can improve the game's controller support.

PLEASE NOTE: Controller support is currently only available for users who are playing using the English language option. Controller support for other languages will follow in a future update.

notes.title: New patch available (1.0.1)
notes.content: Just one fix for this patch. Should be a fix for the plain screen on boot. If you are still having problems, please let us know.
